anchor_definition: The anchor is the login request param-builder (a regenerator state machine) whose body computes the password hash and binds it to the request: it calls the md5 routine on the password and uppercases it, placing the result in the hash field of the login params. The bundle is string-array obfuscated (field names via Qe([...])) and the md5 routine itself is a reassigned local that cannot be isolated as its own function, so this param-builder is the shallowest localizable function that constructs the hash value. The Qe string-decoder is a deobfuscation helper, not the answer.

anchor.why: The regenerator that assembles the account-login request params; its case-0 builds the params object including hash: <md5>(i.password).toUpperCase(), i.e. the observed uppercase MD5 password hash bound to the request.

roles.why: The string-array decoder used to obfuscate property names; a deobfuscation helper, not the password-hash constructor.
